CustomField.description: THE OWNER, never the key. Addendum 20: the person stays on the row as owner. The criterion is the subject because a person naming three criteria is three criteria, and keying on the person would collapse them onto one answer - which is the exact defect this ruling closes. The holder junction at projection is written from here, and it is also the citation for that person's Buyer Role: someone saying it has to integrate with our SAP instance is that person exercising decision authority.
